start_here.desc: Start here tab: numbered steps, how to copy into Google Sheets or open in Excel, what the colors mean, links to every tab. steps: [[title, text]], tip

setup.desc: Setup tab: year, currency note, income sources and spending categories with group (Needs, Wants, Savings, Debt) and monthly budget. Every other tab reads from here. rows: number of category rows (default 30)

months.desc: Twelve month tabs: income received, a spending log with a category dropdown, and budget vs actual per category with progress and over-budget warnings. log_rows (default 80)

dashboard.desc: Dashboard tab: the year by month (income, spent, left over, saved) and spending by category for the year, with a bar chart and a pie chart. Needs months.

bills.desc: Bill tracker: each bill with due day, amount, autopay, and a paid mark for every month. rows (default 25)

debt.desc: Debt payoff: each debt with balance, interest rate and minimum; choose Snowball or Avalanche and an extra monthly amount; shows payoff order and months to pay off at the minimum. rows (default 10)

savings.desc: Savings goals: goal, target, saved so far, progress bar, target date and how much to save per month. rows (default 10)

capabilities.notes: Delivered as .xlsx (opens in Excel and in Google Sheets via File > Import or a copy link). Fonts: use fonts that exist in both Google Sheets and Excel (Arial, Calibri fallback).

style_rules.rule: Every page must be reachable by links from the first page. Groups of pages that only link to each other count as unreachable.
Setup steps must work for a buyer on any purchase date in the selling window, for example before the dated year starts. Walk through day one for an early buyer and a mid-year buyer.
Every number or fact in the listing (pages, file size, what is and isn't included) must match the built file. Rebuilds change counts; update the copy.
Use only glyphs the embedded fonts contain. Draw arrows and icons as SVG, otherwise a non-licensed fallback font gets embedded.
A listing photo must show what its copy and alt text claim. A small multi-page grid needs captions and readable pages (2x2 beats 4 in a row).
No half-empty pages. Fill spare space with something a buyer uses (a map of the top bar, a month jump grid, a pen test area), never decoration.
Never promise service levels in the product (for example 'we reply fast'). Say what the buyer can do instead.
A week that spans two months is built once, under the month that holds its Thursday; day pages name their own month in the trail.
